prompt:
Write a pytest test module at test/morphometrics/test_filter_morphometrics.py for
AxonDeepSeg/morphometrics/filter_morphometrics.py (the `axondeepseg_filter` CLI).

Follow the conventions of the existing tests in test/morphometrics (a `TestCore` class, tests marked
with `@pytest.mark.unit`). Cover `read_config` (default config file and error cases),
`apply_myelinated_rules` and `apply_unmyelinated_rules` (each rule, threshold edge cases, disabled
rules, unknown rules), and `main()` end to end on small morphometrics files created in `tmp_path`.
Do not modify filter_morphometrics.py. The tests must pass on the current code.
final_answer:
All 23 tests pass successfully. The test file at `test/morphometrics/test_filter_morphometrics.py` provides comprehensive coverage of the `filter_morphometrics.py` module:

**Summary of tests:**

| Function | Tests | Coverage |
|----------|-------|----------|
| `read_config` | 5 | Default config file, FileNotFoundError, missing keys, extra keys, default YAML loading |
| `apply_myelinated_rules` | 6 | `valid-g-ratio-only`, `axon-diam-gt` with threshold/None/zero, unknown rule, combined rules |
| `apply_unmyelinated_rules` | 6 | `axon-diam-gt`, `solidity-gt`, `axon-area-lt`, combined rules, unknown rule, None threshold |
| `main()` | 6 | File filtering, overwrite flag, both axon types, single file input, mask update, disabled rules |

The tests cover:
- Edge cases (None thresholds disabled rules, zero thresholds)
- Error handling (FileNotFoundError, ValueError for missing/extra keys)
- End-to-end integration with temporary files and masks
- Mask update functionality with instance maps
